haikus.haiku:
Pineapple shines bright
Sugar drips like summer light
Batter swirls, joy lifts
Happy #NationalPineappleUpsideDownCakeDay from @ClamBakeSanta

Sunrise paints gold light
Birds sing soft as clouds drift by
Leaves whisper bright joy
Happy #BeautifulDay from @Clam

Star dust twinkles bright
Galaxies hum in night sky
Joy climbs comet trail
#HappyBirthdayEdwinHubble from @ClamBakeSanta
